PropertyGrid$new()

Create a property grid. See property_grid().

Usage

PropertyGrid$new(
  data = list(),
  formatter = NULL,
  max_key_width = 20L,
  id = NULL,
  classes = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  disabled = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

Named list/vector or data frame.

formatter

Optional value formatter.

max_key_width

Maximum key width.

id, classes, style, disabled

See property_grid().
